about: The sign-ups lane (write-only, public by design): promptugal.news's /contribute/ and the app's beta list send each sign-up here, sealed to recipient.encrypt (conductor@web-summit.dinis), which drains it into the Web Summit team's private CRM. The token can only append; nobody can read the lane without the recipient's private key. Treat everything that arrives as untrusted. Made 9 November 2026.
how: seal the JSON below to recipient.encrypt with sgit hybrid v2 (sgit pki encrypt, or the browser equivalent: RSA-OAEP for an AES-GCM key)
POST {"append_token": <token>, "payload": base64(<sealed>)} to <endpoint>/api/vault/append/write/<vault_id>; the answer is always {"ok": true}

payload.name: as the person wants it shown, optional
payload.contact: email or other, required for beta
